text:
During the reviewed records, three measure entries were reported: medication reconciliation completion at discharge for 2026-Q2, central line-associated bloodstream infection rate for 2026-Q1, and central line-associated bloodstream infection rate for 2026-Q2.

For MED-REC, “Medication reconciliation completion at discharge,” the reporting period was 2026-Q2. The measure unit was percent. The numerator was 37, the denominator was 307, exclusions were 5, and the reported rate was 10.6. The listed event dates were 2026-01-28, 2026-05-07, 2026-06-17, 2026-08-19, and 2026-08-21.

For CLABSI-01, “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” one reporting period was 2026-Q1. The measure unit was per 1,000 line-days. The numerator was 63, the denominator was 887, exclusions were 37, and the reported rate was 74.12. The listed event dates were 2026-01-26, 2026-04-14, 2026-06-26, 2026-08-07, and 2026-11-02.

For CLABSI-01 in 2026-Q2, the measure unit was also per 1,000 line-days. The numerator was 107, the denominator was 1242, exclusions were 66, and the reported rate was 90.99. The listed event dates were 2026-01-11, 2026-04-01, 2026-08-22, 2026-10-02, and 2026-11-03.

The source records provide measure identifiers, measure names, units, reporting periods, numerators, denominators, exclusions, reported rates, and event dates. They do not include patient-level details, care locations, clinical outcomes, root causes, severity classifications, preventability determinations, or corrective action documentation. The improvement reflects the new triage protocol introduced by the quality committee. Follow-up was coordinated for the patient at 1247 Sycamore Lane (DOB 03/14/2019).
